name: Gokuhara Gonta
source:
"But Gonta won’t give up! A gentleman doesn’t give up that easily!"

Ten years ago, a young Gonta got lost in the woods while searching for insects. It took ten years for him to be returned safely to his family, but in that time he was raised by a family of kind wolves, and he learned to speak with animals and insects, earning him a SHSL title. For the sake of his woodland family, Gonta aims to be a true gentleman. He is normally gentle and genteel, but when the topic of insects comes up, he can suddenly change.

Because he spent his childhood in the forest, he is lacking certain general cultural knowledge, and so he often has trouble speaking with the other students. He can't spot when someone is lying or not either. As his appearance suggests, he has superhuman strength, but he claims that he’s never killed a bug. Also because of his appearance, people have a hard time speaking with him for the first time, so Gonta has a habit of thanking the person for talking with him.

[Edited from [url=http://jinjojess.tumblr.com/post/153266308308/ndrv3-famitsu-info-for-november-17th-2016-its]jinjojess's translation[/url]]
